notes: All timed checkouts were clean. Isolated runs were serial baseline then candidate, three each; full Electron runs were three alternating pairs, ten seconds each.
Headed Chromium and Electron both reported Radeon 880M / D3D11. Their workloads and output sizes differ; do not combine them.
Callback/submission rates are not physical display FPS.

Per-window legacy hardware diagnostics match by effect ID and are ambiguous for duplicate editor instances; negative editor rates are invalid. Independent index-based lifecycle evidence verifies every monitor counter freezes.
The initial broad Electron selection retained a 101ms/100ms seek-budget failure. Isolated main and candidate checks passed; no assertion was relaxed.

Isolated fixture/instrumentation files match exactly; the candidate mixed-effects helper only adds live/static preview plumbing and defaults to live. Isolated batches were not interleaved; use them for architecture counts, not a causal speedup claim.

After measurements, a focused follow-up fixes stable-style video polling and media wake/settle listeners. The measured saved deck has no video; these measurements remain attributed to aa0dee9, not the later evidence/video commit.
